tab.label: Datasets
tab.title: Datasets
tab.description: Frozen, citable copies of this experiment's data. The experiment itself stays editable.

failedAt.verify_one: Checking the files failed after {{count}} try
failedAt.verify_other: Checking the files failed after {{count}} tries

zenodoCopy.requestPrepared: Zenodo's copy: request prepared, not yet removed

list.empty: A dataset is a frozen, citable copy of this experiment's data. Publishing one leaves the experiment itself editable.
list.membersOnly: Only this experiment's members can open it

withdraw.title: Withdraw version {{version}}
withdraw.description: Withdraw a dataset only when it must not stay public, for example because it holds data it should not. This cannot be undone.

consequences.files: openJII stops serving its files to everyone, signed in or not.
consequences.tombstone: Its page becomes a tombstone that keeps the title, authors and DOI and shows your reason.
consequences.zenodo: openJII prepares a withdrawal request to Zenodo with the same reason. Zenodo's copy stays public until Zenodo acts on it.
consequences.doi: The DOI {{doi}} keeps resolving to Zenodo's record.

withdraw.reasonPublic: This reason is public. It shows on the dataset's page and in the request to Zenodo.

scope.tablesDescription: Choose which of the experiment's data tables this dataset holds.
scope.untimed: No time column, so it goes in whole or not at all.
scope.datesDescription: Only readings taken between these dates go in, as calendar days in UTC. The range starts at the first reading and ends at the last.
scope.choiceNote: Single readings are left out in the next step, Curate. The copy is made at the last step, Freeze, and readings added after that are not in it.
scope.dictionaryDetail: The included tables' columns, each with its description
scope.layoutDetail: The plots and where they sit
scope.studyDetailsDetail: Title, dates, location, subjects, design, funding and license
scope.firstVersionDetail: This dataset becomes version 1 of the experiment. A later version starts from these tables and dates.
scope.versionMore: Version {{previous}} holds {{previousCount}} readings, and this choice holds {{difference}} more before Curate. Version {{previous}} stays as it was published.
scope.versionFewer: Version {{previous}} holds {{previousCount}} readings, and this choice holds {{difference}} fewer before Curate. Version {{previous}} stays as it was published.
scope.versionSame: Version {{previous}} holds {{previousCount}} readings, as many as this choice before Curate. Version {{previous}} stays as it was published.
scope.publicExperimentNote: Making the experiment public in its settings is separate. That opens the live experiment to signed-in researchers, while a dataset is a frozen copy anyone can open.

curate.title: Flagged readings
curate.description: Readings flagged on the Data tab or in the app. An excluded reading is left out of the dataset's files and stays in the experiment. The dataset page says how many were left out, never which.
curate.viewReading: Open the reading on {{plot}} on the Data tab
curate.excludedCount_one: {{count}} reading will be left out of the dataset.
curate.excludedCount_other: {{count}} readings will be left out of the dataset.
curate.none: No readings are flagged, so the dataset holds every reading.
curate.loadError: Could not load the flagged readings.

plotChecks.measuredTwiceDescription: More than one reading landed on these plots without a repeat being asked for. Freeze waits until each is resolved, whatever the experiment follows.
plotChecks.skippedDescription: Skipped and not measured again that day. They never hold Freeze, and they start the limitations statement in Describe.
plotChecks.none: No plot was measured twice or left skipped.
plotChecks.loadError: Could not load the plots measured twice and skipped.

describe.detailsDescription: Prefilled from the experiment. Edit them for this dataset.
describe.peopleDescription: Everyone in the experiment is listed. Mark each person as an author, a contributor or neither. Everyone you name is asked to accept.
describe.authorsGroupHelp: Drag a row to move it.
describe.contributorsGroupHelp: Credited in the dataset's record with their part, not in the citation.
describe.neitherGroupHelp: Members who are neither an author nor a contributor of this dataset.
describe.byEmailHelp: For someone without an openJII account. They accept after signing up, as with an organization invitation.
describe.hostingDetail: ROR {{ror}}. openJII names it in every dataset's record.
describe.orcidInfo_one: {{names}} has not connected an ORCID iD, so is cited by name. Nothing waits for it.
describe.orcidInfo_other: {{names}} have not connected an ORCID iD, so they are cited by name. Nothing waits for them.
describe.requestInfo_one: {{names}} has not accepted yet, and Freeze waits until they do.
describe.requestInfo_other: {{names}} have not accepted yet, and Freeze waits until they do.
describe.authorsFinal: Authors cannot be changed after you publish.
describe.limitationsHelp: What a reader should know before reusing this data, such as gaps or conditions it does not cover.

license.title: Data license
license.description: Prefilled from the study details. The data is published under this license.
license.cc0Detail: No rights reserved. Anyone may reuse the data without giving credit.
license.ccByDetail: Anyone may reuse the data as long as they credit the authors.
license.ccBySaDetail: Anyone may reuse the data if they credit the authors and share what they build under the same license.
license.shareAlikeWarning: Share-alike data cannot be merged into CC0 or CC BY datasets, and it may not meet the terms of a Horizon Europe grant.
license.permanentNote: A license cannot be taken back once the dataset is published.
license.metadataNote: The dataset's metadata is always published under CC0, whatever the data license.
license.rightToPublish: I have the right to publish this data under the chosen license.

access.title: Access
access.description: The title, authors and citation become public once a data steward approves the dataset. Choose when its files open.
access.openDetail: Anyone can download the files once the dataset is approved.
access.embargoedDetail: The files open by themselves on the date. It can be brought forward later from the Datasets tab, or moved later once with a reason.

check.recordDescription: Every dataset follows it. The steps of this flow fill it, so OpenAIRE, the European open-science catalogue, can harvest the dataset.
check.blocked: Freeze waits until every step above is done.

freeze.title: What becomes public
freeze.description: Read this before freezing. Once the dataset is frozen, none of it can be changed.
freeze.accessOpen: The title, authors, citation and files become public together, once a data steward approves the dataset.
freeze.accessEmbargoed: The title, authors and citation become public on approval, and the files open on {{date}}.
freeze.filesAlways: With the data dictionary of those tables, the layout and the study details

commits.review: A data steward reviews the dataset before its page opens. Until then only the experiment's members can see it.
commits.frozen: Its files never change. A mistake found later becomes a new version.
commits.final: Its license cannot be taken back, and its authors cannot be changed.
commits.experiment: Once the dataset opens, the experiment can be archived, but never deleted.

freeze.confirmDescription: The dataset goes to a data steward for review and never changes after this. Its page opens and its DOI is minted only once it is approved. The experiment itself stays editable.

page.notFound: This dataset does not exist or is not public.
page.frozenNotice: This is a frozen dataset of a live experiment, so its files never change. The live experiment itself needs an openJII account.
page.previewDetail: Only the experiment's members and data stewards can open this page. It opens to everyone once a data steward approves it.

aboutFields.dictionaryValue: Every column, with what it measures

fileDetails.snapshot: Every reading the dataset holds, as taken
fileDetails.dataDictionary: Every column, with what it measures
fileDetails.analysisTable: One row per reading with its plot's attributes, and a codebook for each column
fileDetails.roCrate: Describes every file of this dataset

page.embargoDetail: The title, authors and citation are public now. The files are withheld until that date.
page.supersededDetail: Version {{version}} supersedes this one. This version stays as it was published, so citations of it still hold.
page.testDetail: This dataset was deposited in Zenodo's sandbox from a test environment. Its DOI is a test, so no citation is offered.
page.withdrawnFiles: openJII no longer serves its files.
page.withdrawnDoi: Its DOI, {{doi}}, resolves to Zenodo's record.

withdrawnZenodo.requestPrepared: Zenodo's copy stays public until Zenodo acts on the withdrawal request.
withdrawnZenodo.removed: Zenodo has withdrawn its copy and shows its own tombstone.

catalogue.title: Datasets
catalogue.description: Every published dataset on openJII, each a frozen, citable copy of an experiment's data.

review.title: Review datasets
review.description: Frozen datasets waiting for a data steward. Approving one opens its page and starts its deposit, and returning one sends it back to Draft with your reason.
review.loadError: Could not load the datasets waiting for review.
review.empty: No dataset is waiting for review.
review.frozenBy: From {{experiment}}, frozen by {{name}} on {{date}}. The page and files below are exactly what opens on approval.
review.checklistDescription: Read the page and open the files, then confirm each point. If one does not hold, return the dataset with a reason.

checks.personalData: The files and the description hold no personal data
checks.rightToLicense: The researchers may publish this data under its license
checks.authors: The authors and contributors are the people who made the data
checks.description: The description and limitations say what the data is and what it does not cover

review.approveDetail: The page opens on data.openjii.org, the authors are told, and the deposit in Zenodo starts.
review.returnDescription: The dataset goes back to Draft and its frozen files are deleted, so nobody outside the experiment ever saw them.
review.reasonHelp: The researcher reads it on the dataset's row on the Datasets tab.
